title: Maintenance Engineer
summary: A maintenance engineer keeps a plant's machines and utilities running by planning preventive maintenance and fixing breakdowns fast. Early-career maintenance engineers work in the plant maintenance team under a maintenance manager, tracking MTTR and MTBF (average repair time and time between failures), handling spares and following lock-out safety rules.
dailyDuties: Carry out preventive maintenance as per the PM schedule
Attend breakdowns and restore machines quickly
Troubleshoot hydraulic, pneumatic and mechanical faults
Apply lock-out tag-out and work permits before each job
Record breakdowns and update MTTR and MTBF figures
Raise and close maintenance orders in SAP PM
Check critical spares stock and raise purchase requests

skills.expectation: Carry out preventive and breakdown maintenance on plant machines
Track MTTR, MTBF and downtime and reduce repeat breakdowns
Troubleshoot hydraulic and pneumatic circuits, valves and cylinders
Maintain bearings, gearboxes, pumps and drives, including alignment and lubrication
Apply lock-out tag-out and work permits before every maintenance job
Do why-why analysis on breakdowns and close the actions
Read machine and circuit drawings during repairs
Hand over shift status clearly to production and the next maintenance shift
Read PLC ladder logic to find faults on the electrical side
Raise notifications and close maintenance orders in SAP PM or a CMMS
Keep critical spares at min-max levels and plan spare purchases
Keep maintenance logs and KPI sheets
Take part in TPM and kaizen activities
